label: Rule-54 local sensor gate
title: Can a local Groovy bit select a repair site?
summary: On the frozen Rule-54 route task, a one-bit G trigger never picks a unique site (340/1,156), while one raw five-bit pattern rescues 34 more trials under the same arbiter (374/1,156).
takeaway: The complete G field still retains the repair decision, but this local G grammar has no advantage over a simpler raw selector. No cross-rule repair sweep is warranted by it.
